main.description: Lifts a ban, letting the community issue the subject space credentials again.

community.description: The community to lift the ban in.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for lifting the ban.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the member.unban permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: NotBanned
errors.description: The subject is not currently banned from this community.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.
